_doc: Reviewed exceptions for devtools/hygiene_check.py (fix wave 25, founder ruling R-HYGIENE). 'allow': static-lint exceptions — rule, path, optional function, optional 'contains' (a snippet of the flagged line), and a mandatory reason; `lint --strict-allowlist` (CI) fails an entry that matches nothing. 'expected_skips': per suite id, the skip reasons that are legitimate on some machine (regex over the reason pytest/go/cargo/node reports); any other skip fails the run (rule R5). Add an entry only with a reason a reviewer can check.

allow.reason: Guards against a retry/backoff loop when the ledger is down (the alternative is waiting out the 10 s upstream client timeout). The measured path is one refused loopback connect plus a 502 written by an in-process httptest server — no CPU-bound work, milliseconds — so 2 s is a >100x margin, and the structural half of the property (zero detection calls) is asserted separately. Reviewed fix wave 25 (E-C).
